news.title: IU Climate Week highlights solutions to environmental challenges
news.summary_en: Learn about IU’s inaugural Climate Week, featuring campus events, expert talks, and hands-on activities focused on climate solutions and sustainability.

news.title: Denison University and O’Neill School announce partnership
news.summary_en: Through a partnership with the O’Neill School, eligible Denison alumni can pursue graduate study in public and environmental affairs, with a 25% tuition reduction and an application fee waiver.

news.title: O'Neill School ready to shine at ARNOVA Conference
news.summary_en: O’Neill School faculty and doctoral students will share research at the 2026 ARNOVA Conference, advancing nonprofit, philanthropy, and civil society scholarship.
